semiconductor_relevance: High — Fujian Fudou New Material Co., Ltd. specializes in the production of electronic special gases and semiconductor precursors, which are critical for various semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Fujian Fudou New Material Co., Ltd. develops and manufactures a wide range of electronic special gases and semiconductor precursors essential for Ultra Large Scale Integration manufacturing. Their products, including HBr and BCl, are utilized in cleaning, etching, and deposition processes across multiple semiconductor applications.
capabilities: Production of over 30 types of electronic gases
Manufacturing of more than 10 semiconductor precursors
Specialty gases for cleaning and etching processes
Bulk supply capabilities for integrated circuit and third-generation semiconductor industries

regional_presence.China: The company is based in China and has established itself as a supplier for various domestic semiconductor industries.
